text: DSH Git Review 是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，在会话视图中增加 Review 标签页，并通过宿主端接口展示工作区文件树、变更差异和提交图。用户可以筛选和比较文件、查看历史及 blame、评论差异行、预览文件，并执行暂存、提交、分支、标签、stash 和冲突处理等 Git 操作。它适合希望在 DSH 内审阅 agent 工作区改动并管理 Git 的开发者；宿主环境需要安装 git，不需要额外 API 密钥。

DSH Git Review adds a Review tab to DSH Web sessions for workspace files, diffs, and commit history. Inspect changes, search files, view blame, comment on diffs, preview files, and manage staging, commits, branches, tags, and conflicts. Git must be installed on the host.
想在 DSH 会话里直接检查工作区有哪些文件改动。
有没有办法并排比较两个 Git 分支或提交之间的差异？
我想查看提交历史、每次提交改了哪些文件。
需要在审查差异时给具体代码行留言并留作草稿。
怎样从界面暂存文件、写提交并管理分支？
想在差异视图里快速搜索文件名和代码内容。
I want to review file changes and commit history without leaving my DSH session.
Can I stage changes, create commits, and manage branches from a review screen?
How can I inspect a file's blame and past versions while reviewing a change?
DSH Git Review 的功能「变更与差异审阅」：在会话的 Review 标签页查看文件树和差异，可按工作区状态或两个引用进行比较，并搜索变更内容。
DSH Git Review 的功能「提交历史」：通过提交图浏览提交、文件差异、blame 和文件历史，并查看历史版本。
DSH Git Review 的功能「Git 工作区操作」：在变更审阅界面暂存或撤销文件与区块、提交并推送，也可处理分支、标签、stash 和合并冲突。
DSH Git Review 的功能「逐行评论」：审阅者可对差异中的代码行添加评论，并将内容放入会话 composer 草稿。

dsh-git-review README · What it does：DSH Git Review registers a **Review** tab next to Chat and Trajectory in the session view. It shows the workspace repository against HEAD — or any two refs — and lets you act on what you see without leaving the tab:

dsh-git-review README · What it does：- **Review first**: filterable file tree with status badges, side-by-side / unified / full-file diffs, hunk folding, word-level change highlights, syntax coloring, and diff search across file names, diff text, and file content. Keyboard-first: `j`/`k` move between files, `/` focuses search.
- **Decide with history**: a lane commit graph with per-commit files and diffs, blame gutters, per-file history, and reading any file version from history.
- **Act under guard**: stage / unstage / discard per file or per hunk, commit (plus amend, Ctrl+Enter), commit-and-push, and push; branches (create / switch / rename / delete / merge / track remotes) with fetch and pull; history operations (reset / revert / cherry-pick, per-commit actions from the graph); lightweight tags (create / delete / push); stash; and merge-conflict resolution (ours / theirs, continue / abort). Every write needs explicit confirmation, destructive ones ask twice, and everything locks while the agent is running.
- **Close the loop**: comment on any diff line and drop it into the composer draft, mark files reviewed (auto-cleared when the file changes again), and keep comment drafts per

dsh-git-review README · What it does：Preferences (diff layout, default search scope, graph shape, matching, whitespace, syntax) live in the harness settings Plugins tab and sync instantly with the Review tab.

dsh-git-review README · Install：From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-git-review
dsh web
```

Or from a local tarball:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-git-review-<version>.tgz  # the exact filename pnpm pack prints

dsh-git-review README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.1.2-rc.1` through `0.2.0-rc.1` (prerelease series are pinned one by one in `peerDependencies`) and git on the host PATH. Outside a git repository the tab offers file browsing with one-click `git init` instead of the review workbench — never a blank screen. Display preferences live in the configuration the harness serves for this plugin's entry: its own `.volatile()` fields keyed by the profile entry id from `0.1.7-alpha.1` on, the Plugins page's entry for this plugin from `0.1.6-alpha.2` on, or the settings modal's plugin cards before that.

dsh-git-review README · Checks：```bash
pnpm typecheck      # strict, noEmit
pnpm check:parse    # pure-function regression (Node >= 23.6 native TS stripping)
pnpm check:git      # real-git fixture integration (repositories under .tmp-check-git/)
pnpm build          # lib/index.js (node) + lib/client.js (browser factory bundle)

dsh-git-review README · How it works：- **Host half**: an in-process cordis plugin serving a fenced prefix route for versioned API actions over JSON (non-JSON bodies get 415, which also closes the classic no-cors write vectors). Every path is fenced inside the session workspace repository, every ref is re-resolved server-side, commit ids only travel as 40-hex, and GIT_DIR-style environment hijacks are scrubbed.
- **Client half**: a conversation-view slot component; the host route is optional — without it the tab says so instead of erroring.
- **Scale guards**: 20k-row render cap, 2 MiB per-file diff cap, 500-commit graph pages with load-more, an 8 MiB streaming byte cap on the largest git answers plus a separate 8 MiB preview cap (both truncate instead of buffering whole), and exact-count probing within a 32 MiB per-status budget.
- Interface languages: Simplified Chinese and English, following the harness locale; dark and light themes via semantic tokens.
